plMouldCosting.title: Mould costing
plMouldCosting.subtitle: What each mould cost and what it adds to every piece it makes

how.title: How the mould cost per piece is worked out
how.formula: Mould cost per piece = (cost + upkeep) ÷ life in shots ÷ cavities

cost.title: Cost
cost.body: The mould's cost on the register (bought or made).

upkeep.title: Upkeep
upkeep.body: Services and repairs recorded on the mould.

life.title: Life in shots
life.body: The shots the mould is expected to make in its life.

plMouldCosting.missingTitle: {{n}} mould(s) have no cost yet, so their cost per piece is missing (never guessed):
plMouldCosting.missingNext: Add the cost and the life in shots on the Mould register.
plMouldCosting.emptyBody: Add moulds on the Mould register first.

quote.title: Cost sheet for a new mould (quotation)
